description: Do something to the device itself: rotate (orientation), shake (shake-to-undo, shake-to-report, dev menus), clipboard (text on the clipboard for a real paste), biometrics (Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint match or fail). iOS Simulator, physical iPhone (rotate, clipboard) and Android (rotate, emulator shake and fingerprint). Returns the screen after when the app is connected (not for clipboard).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

fingerId.description: biometrics on an Android emulator: the finger id to touch: an enrolled one for a match (default 1), one that is not enrolled for a failure (default 9731).

match.description: biometrics: true for a match (default), false for a failed one.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

name: device_control
